name: word-corners
description: Mobile-friendly word game. The game itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies — wrangler is here only to run and deploy the Cloudflare Worker + D1 backend.

scripts.db:games: wrangler d1 execute word-corners-staging --env staging --remote --command="SELECT * FROM games ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:games:production: wrangler d1 execute word-corners --remote --command="SELECT * FROM games ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:objectives: wrangler d1 execute word-corners-staging --env staging --remote --command="SELECT json_extract(params,'$.property') AS property, json_extract(params,'$.length') AS len, json_extract(params,'$.exclude') AS excl, json_extract(params,'$.scope') AS scope, json_extract(params,'$.constraint') AS rule, json_extract(params,'$.count') AS n, cost, COUNT(*) AS dealt, ROUND(AVG(completed) * 100, 1) AS pct FROM game_objectives GROUP BY params, cost ORDER BY cost, pct"
scripts.db:objectives:production: wrangler d1 execute word-corners --remote --command="SELECT json_extract(params,'$.property') AS property, json_extract(params,'$.length') AS len, json_extract(params,'$.exclude') AS excl, json_extract(params,'$.scope') AS scope, json_extract(params,'$.constraint') AS rule, json_extract(params,'$.count') AS n, cost, COUNT(*) AS dealt, ROUND(AVG(completed) * 100, 1) AS pct FROM game_objectives GROUP BY params, cost ORDER BY cost, pct"
scripts.db:moves: wrangler d1 execute word-corners-staging --env staging --remote --command="SELECT game_version, mode_id, difficulty, COUNT(*) AS games, ROUND(AVG(moves_total)) AS avg_moves, MIN(moves_total) AS min_moves, MAX(moves_total) AS max_moves, ROUND(AVG(CAST(moves_total AS REAL) / NULLIF(words_total, 0)), 2) AS moves_per_word FROM games WHERE moves_total > 0 GROUP BY game_version, mode_id, difficulty ORDER BY game_version, mode_id, difficulty"
scripts.db:moves:production: wrangler d1 execute word-corners --remote --command="SELECT game_version, mode_id, difficulty, COUNT(*) AS games, ROUND(AVG(moves_total)) AS avg_moves, MIN(moves_total) AS min_moves, MAX(moves_total) AS max_moves, ROUND(AVG(CAST(moves_total AS REAL) / NULLIF(words_total, 0)), 2) AS moves_per_word FROM games WHERE moves_total > 0 GROUP BY game_version, mode_id, difficulty ORDER BY game_version, mode_id, difficulty"
scripts.db:costs: wrangler d1 execute word-corners-staging --env staging --remote --command="SELECT cost, COUNT(*) AS dealt, ROUND(AVG(completed) * 100, 1) AS pct, COUNT(DISTINCT params) AS tunings FROM game_objectives GROUP BY cost ORDER BY cost"
scripts.db:costs:production: wrangler d1 execute word-corners --remote --command="SELECT cost, COUNT(*) AS dealt, ROUND(AVG(completed) * 100, 1) AS pct, COUNT(DISTINCT params) AS tunings FROM game_objectives GROUP BY cost ORDER BY cost"
